div.style: color: rgb(31, 45, 61) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
managed_devices
PK id
UNIQUE device_id
status / disabled_at

div.style: color: rgb(31, 45, 61) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
managed_device_keys
PK id
FK device_id -> managed_devices.id
UNIQUE key_id
algorithm / status

div.style: color: rgb(31, 45, 61) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
ingest_requests
PK id
UNIQUE idempotency_key
payload_hash
ingest_status / retry_count
FK event_id -> events.id

div.style: color: rgb(31, 45, 61) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
events
PK id
device_id / batch_id / timestamp
sensor_payload / signature_envelope
UNIQUE canonical_hash

div.style: color: rgb(31, 45, 61) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

FK event_id

FK event_id

div.style: color: rgb(31, 45, 61) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

actor / action / target

div.style: color: rgb(31, 45, 61) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 双层幂等：ingest_requests.idempotency_key 处理请求重放，events.canonical_hash 处理内容重复。
